title: Eliminator Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Bell Eliminator Gloss Black delivers authentic custom flair backed by modern impact mitigation, pairing relaxed road ergonomics with modern certified protection. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1459g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~94 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Flat-track inspired cruiser helmet with ProVision anti-fog shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Standard Bell fit; slightly roomy in the crown compared to Snell-certified models, requires cheek pads for a secure lock on narrow heads.

technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Eliminator Gloss Black: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Bell Eliminator Gloss Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Bell Eliminator Gloss Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Full Face lineup, the Eliminator Gloss Black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Bell Eliminator Gloss Black represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~94 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Eliminator Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
